# Ordo AI — Anchor Mirror

Read-only public mirror of `docs/system/` from the private
`smcgivern1/ordo-ai` repo. Auto-synced on every change to
the anchor.

**Do not edit here.** Edits will be overwritten on the next
sync. The source of truth is the private repo.

## Files

- `AI_BOOTSTRAP.md` — operating rules
- `TECH_SNAPSHOT.md` — current architecture (auto-generated)
- `STATE_OF_PLAY.md` — what works, what doesn't, recent
  commits, tech debt, risks
- `BUILD_PLAN.md` — current scope, future phases
